entries.dialogueText: "Sure, until we have to send in badgers to eat the snails, hawks to eat the badgers and mountain lions to eat the hawks. Is that what you want?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your scholarly mind never stops wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your scholarly mind never stops working, does it? Rest assured your King has everything under control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was for myself as much as you...."
entries.dialogueText: "It was for myself as much as you. I want my childhood home in Monqiz to remain as pristine as it is in my memories."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""No... I suppose I failed to think..."
entries.dialogueText: "No... I suppose I failed to think through the consequences."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Thank you, Your Majesty. I never d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I never doubted you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It smelled fine to me. But write m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It smelled fine to me. But write me if the problem gets out of hand. I wouldn't want anything spoiling our province's natural beauty."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Nor would I. Thank you, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nor would I. Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""It's fine, Your Majesty. I know ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine, Your Majesty. I know how many demands you have on your attention and resources."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""No, no. I understand the benefits..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, no. I understand the benefits the project will bring to the region. But you know the nobles here -- always concerned about their property values."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""A lovely sentiment. I share it mys..."
entries.dialogueText: "A lovely sentiment. I share it myself."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I feel precisely the same way. Onl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel precisely the same way. Only in the furthest reaches of Neqis and Sonsamia have I encountered such a mesmerizing diversity of biomes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was the least I could do. God f..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was the least I could do. God forbid the Valenqiris nobility actually catch a whiff of the industries they're profiting off of."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""We're grateful for the benefits th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're grateful for the benefits the project will bring to the region, Your Majesty. But declining property values were a concern for some time."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""I convinced the Cantuavos' chef to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I convinced the Cantuavos' chef to put njorla on the menu. It's a Galmish dish made with toasted barley and raw salmon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Raw salmon? Do you intend for the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Raw salmon? Do you intend for the Royal Family to leave this party in body bags?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds delicious. I'll give it a t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds delicious. I'll give it a try."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Galmish, you say? Let me guess, it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Galmish, you say? Let me guess, it'll be a tiny portion divided equally between all one hundred guests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm glad you've kept your taste fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm glad you've kept your taste for adventure while stuck here in Valenqiris."

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Oh, I hardly miss my travels at al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I hardly miss my travels at all. Catering to this lot is its own adventure."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Ha! I don't care for Galmland's po..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! I don't care for Galmland's politics either, but their cuisine is fascinating."

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""With proper handling, it's every b..."
entries.dialogueText: "With proper handling, it's every bit as safe as cooked. And it goes perfectly with your wine."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Must you subject all of Valenqiris..."
entries.dialogueText: "Must you subject all of Valenqiris to the whims of your palate, Your Grace?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo couldn't hide his look of disg..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo couldn't hide his look of disgust.

entries.speaker: Hubertus Toras
entries.title: Hubertus Toras: ""Come now. The monarchy may be root..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come now. The monarchy may be rooted in tradition, but our food needn't be."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gestured at the assembled guests..."
entries.dialogueText: He gestured at the assembled guests.
